tasks.verified: The ECS service runs a new revision whose image is mott-lane-57, reached only after the task re-proved the image exists in ECR and byte-matches the lane-57 artifact; the service is stable on that exact revision.
tasks.spec:
AWS_PROFILE=deploy-admin python3 -u - <<'PY' > deploy.txt 2>&1
import gzip, io, json, tarfile, urllib.request
import boto3
REPO = "eyecloud-fargate-runner"
NEW_TAG = "mott-lane-57"
BASE_REV = "mott-booking-gateway:72"
BASE_IMG_SUFFIX = ":mott-lane-56"
FIXED = "/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW57/gw-vocab4-consolidated/fixed-bland_gateway.py"
ecr = boto3.client("ecr", region_name="us-east-1")
ecs = boto3.client("ecs", region_name="us-east-1")
imgs = ecr.describe_images(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageTag": NEW_TAG}])["imageDetails"]
assert imgs and imgs[0].get("imageDigest", "").startswith("sha256:"), "GUARD: %s not in ECR - refusing to deploy" % NEW_TAG
m = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageTag": NEW_TAG}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
if "manifests" in m:
    e = next(x for x in m["manifests"] if x.get("platform", {}).get("architecture") in ("amd64", "x86_64"))
    m = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageDigest": e["digest"]}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
url = ecr.get_download_url_for_layer(repositoryName=REPO, layerDigest=m["layers"][-1]["digest"])["downloadUrl"]
tf = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(gzip.decompress(urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=300).read())))
got = tf.extractfile("opt/cvc-booking-gateway/bland_gateway.py").read()
assert got == open(FIXED, "rb").read(), "GUARD: image content does not byte-match the lane-57 artifact - refusing to deploy"
print("GUARD_OK image verified in-task before service update")
td = ecs.describe_task_definition(taskDefinition=BASE_REV)["taskDefinition"]
for k in ("taskDefinitionArn", "revision", "status", "requiresAttributes", "compatibilities", "registeredAt", "registeredBy", "deregisteredAt"):
    td.pop(k, None)
img = td["containerDefinitions"][0]["image"]
assert img.endswith(BASE_IMG_SUFFIX), "GUARD: base rev 72 image unexpectedly %s" % img
td["containerDefinitions"][0]["image"] = img[: -len(BASE_IMG_SUFFIX)] + ":" + NEW_TAG
new = ecs.register_task_definition(**td)["taskDefinition"]
rev = new["revision"]
print("NEW_REVISION=%d" % rev)
ecs.update_service(cluster="stack2", service="mott-booking-gateway", taskDefinition="mott-booking-gateway:%d" % rev)
waiter = ecs.get_waiter("services_stable")
waiter.wait(cluster="stack2", services=["mott-booking-gateway"], WaiterConfig={"Delay": 15, "MaxAttempts": 60})
svc = ecs.describe_services(cluster="stack2", services=["mott-booking-gateway"])["services"][0]
assert svc["taskDefinition"].endswith(":%d" % rev), "stable on %s, not the new revision" % svc["taskDefinition"]
print("STABLE taskdef=%s running=%d desired=%d" % (svc["taskDefinition"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1], svc["runningCount"], svc["desiredCount"]))
print("ROLLBACK_CMD=aws ecs update-service --cluster stack2 --service mott-booking-gateway --task-definition mott-booking-gateway:72")
print("DEPLOY_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat deploy.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q 'GUARD_OK' deploy.txt || { echo 'FAIL: guard did not run:'; tail -6 deploy.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q 'DEPLOY_DONE' deploy.txt || { echo 'FAIL: deploy did not stabilize:'; tail -6 deploy.txt; exit 1; }; grep -qE 'STABLE taskdef=mott-booking-gateway:[0-9]+ running=[1-9]' deploy.txt || { echo 'FAIL: not stable with a running task'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'STABLE' deploy.txt)"
